name: 杏风 · 流云轻弓
design: A cheerful nimble archer's LIGHT WARM APRICOT-WOOD CLOUD BOW: graceful rounded shallow double-S recurve limbs with a slightly compact playful silhouette, honey/apricot golden laminated wood and sage-green inner edge. Each limb root has ONE broad rounded cloud-hook carved profile integrated flush into wood, no dangling pieces, no little jewel mosaic. Warm ivory horn tip caps, soft sage cloth-wrapped central grip with one small simple cloth knot on OUTSIDE of grip clear of fingers/string. SINGLE straight dark bowstring. Full straight arrow of warm light wood with a small smooth silver LEAF point, APRICOT-and-IVORY short rounded feather fletching, sage wrap and visible rear nock. Matching apricot/cream quiver arrow feathers and one simple round cloud stamp on the existing quiver; do not add extra arrows. Curving rounded lively design, not hard angular war bow.
